en.title: Echoes of the Resonant Night and the Flying Ship Weaving Earthly Melodies
en.premise: After Noctopia descended to the surface, the world was greeted not by 'perfect silence,' but by a chaos filled with countless 'noises.' Caelen and Leila, who once played discordant tunes, embark on a wandering journey across the land to trace the memories of lost sound. Before them appear librarians seeking melodies slumbering within old books, and melody-weavers steering flying ships. A journey of melodies begins, to piece together the scattered fragments of sound and find a new tuning for the world.

zh.title: 共鸣之夜的残响，与编织地上旋律的飞空船
zh.premise: 在诺克托比亚降临至地面后，世界迎来的并非“完美的寂静”，而是充斥着无数“杂音”的混沌。曾经奏出不和谐音符的卡埃伦与莱拉，在地面上流浪，踏上了追寻失落之音记忆的旅程。他们的面前，出现了搜寻沉睡在古书中的旋律的图书管理员，以及操纵飞空船的旋律师。一段将破碎的声音碎片重新拼接、寻找新世界音律的旋律之旅，就此拉开序幕。
